verdict.rationale: Docs confirm plan tiers, ability to buy extra credits, and note that starting from existing files uses no tokens (docs-10, docs-23, docs-25), but there's no detailed breakdown of per-action token/credit costs. A community report describes unpredictable, high usage-based costs (>$20/day, $50 for a weekend project), contradicting a clear understanding of consumption (v0-comm-3).
